# Claude Quickstarts

> Anthropic 公式のクイックスタート集。Skill/Rule/Agent などの CC 拡張資産は含まず、エージェント・コンピューターユース・ブラウザ操作・カスタマーサポートなど複数の Claude API デモアプリを収録したサンプルリポジトリ。

---

## Agents

### Agents

*Source: agents/README.md | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/README.md*

# Agents

A minimal educational implementation of LLM agents using the Claude API.

> **Note:** This is NOT an SDK, but a reference implementation of key concepts

## Overview & Core Components

This repo demonstrates how to [build effective agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) with the Claude API. It shows how sophisticated AI behaviors can emerge from a simple foundation: LLMs using tools in a loop. This implementation is not prescriptive - the core logic is <300 lines of code and deliberately lacks production features. Feel free to translate these patterns to your language and production stack ([Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/claude-code/overview) can help!)

It contains three components:

- `agent.py`: Manages Claude API interactions and tool execution
- `tools/`: Tool implementations (both native and MCP tools)
- `utils/`: Utilities for message history and MCP server connections

## Usage

```python
from agents.agent import Agent
from agents.tools.think import ThinkTool

# Create an agent with both local tools and MCP server tools
agent = Agent(
    name="MyAgent",
    system="You are a helpful assistant.",
    tools=[ThinkTool()],  # Local tools
    mcp_servers=[
        {
            "type": "stdio",
            "command": "python",
            "args": ["-m", "mcp_server"],
        },
    ]
)

# Run the agent
response = agent.run("What should I consider when buying a new laptop?")
```

From this foundation, you can add domain-specific tools, optimize performance, or implement custom response handling. We remain deliberately unopinionated - this backbone simply gets you started with fundamentals.

## Requirements

- Python 3.8+
- Claude API key (set as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable)
- `anthropic` Python library
- `mcp` Python library

## Source Modules

### agents.agent

*Source: agents/agent.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/agent.py*

- `ModelConfig`: Configuration settings for Claude model parameters.
- `Agent`: Claude-powered agent with tool use capabilities.
- `run_async`: Run agent with MCP tools asynchronously.
- `run`: Run agent synchronously

### agents.tools.base

*Source: agents/tools/base.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/base.py*

- `Tool`: Base class for all agent tools.
- `to_dict`: Convert tool to Claude API format.
- `execute`: Execute the tool with provided parameters.

### agents.tools.calculator_mcp

*Source: agents/tools/calculator_mcp.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/calculator_mcp.py*

- `calculator`: Performs basic calculations with two numbers.

### agents.tools.code_execution

*Source: agents/tools/code_execution.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/code_execution.py*

- `CodeExecutionServerTool`: Code execution server tool that uses Anthropic's server tool format.
- `to_dict`: Convert to Anthropic server tool format.

### agents.tools.file_tools

*Source: agents/tools/file_tools.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/file_tools.py*

- `FileReadTool`: Tool for reading files and listing directories.
- `execute`: Execute a file read operation.
- `FileWriteTool`: Tool for writing and editing files.
- `execute`: Execute a file write operation.

### agents.tools.mcp_tool

*Source: agents/tools/mcp_tool.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/mcp_tool.py*

- `MCPTool`
- `execute`: Execute the MCP tool with the given input_schema.

### agents.tools.think

*Source: agents/tools/think.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/think.py*

- `ThinkTool`: Tool for internal reasoning without executing external actions.
- `execute`: Simply returns the thought back to the model.

### agents.tools.web_search

*Source: agents/tools/web_search.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/tools/web_search.py*

- `WebSearchServerTool`: Web search server tool that uses Anthropic's server tool format.
- `to_dict`: Convert to Anthropic server tool format.

### agents.utils.connections

*Source: agents/utils/connections.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/utils/connections.py*

- `MCPConnection`: Base class for MCP server connections.
- `list_tools`: Retrieve available tools from the MCP server.
- `call_tool`: Call a tool on the MCP server with provided arguments.
- `MCPConnectionStdio`: MCP connection using standard input/output.
- `MCPConnectionSSE`: MCP connection using Server-Sent Events.
- `create_mcp_connection`: Factory function to create the appropriate MCP connection.
- `setup_mcp_connections`: Set up MCP server connections and create tool interfaces.

### agents.utils.history_util

*Source: agents/utils/history_util.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/utils/history_util.py*

- `MessageHistory`: Manages chat history with token tracking and context management.
- `add_message`: Add a message to the history and track token usage.
- `truncate`: Remove oldest messages when context window limit is exceeded.
- `remove_message_pair`
- `format_for_api`: Format messages for Claude API with optional caching.

### agents.utils.tool_util

*Source: agents/utils/tool_util.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/agents/utils/tool_util.py*

- `execute_tools`: Execute multiple tools sequentially or in parallel.

### autonomous-coding.agent

*Source: autonomous-coding/agent.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/agent.py*

- `run_agent_session`: Run a single agent session using Claude Agent SDK.
- `run_autonomous_agent`: Run the autonomous agent loop.

### autonomous-coding.autonomous_agent_demo

*Source: autonomous-coding/autonomous_agent_demo.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/autonomous_agent_demo.py*

- `parse_args`: Parse command line arguments.
- `main`: Main entry point.

### autonomous-coding.client

*Source: autonomous-coding/client.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/client.py*

- `create_client`: Create a Claude Agent SDK client with multi-layered security.

### autonomous-coding.progress

*Source: autonomous-coding/progress.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/progress.py*

- `count_passing_tests`: Count passing and total tests in feature_list.json.
- `print_session_header`: Print a formatted header for the session.
- `print_progress_summary`: Print a summary of current progress.

### autonomous-coding.prompts

*Source: autonomous-coding/prompts.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/prompts.py*

- `load_prompt`: Load a prompt template from the prompts directory.
- `get_initializer_prompt`: Load the initializer prompt.
- `get_coding_prompt`: Load the coding agent prompt.
- `copy_spec_to_project`: Copy the app spec file into the project directory for the agent to read.

### autonomous-coding.security

*Source: autonomous-coding/security.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts/blob/main/autonomous-coding/security.py*

- `split_command_segments`: Split a compound command into individual command segments.
- `extract_commands`: Extract command names from a shell command string.
- `validate_pkill_command`: Validate pkill commands - only allow killing dev-related processes.
- `validate_chmod_command`: Validate chmod commands - only allow making files executable with +x.
- `validate_init_script`: Validate init.sh script execution - only allow ./init.sh.
- `get_command_for_validation`: Find the specific command segment that contains the given command.
- `bash_security_hook`: Pre-tool-use hook that validates bash commands using an allowlist.

### computer-use-demo.computer_use_demo.tools.edit

- `to_params`
- `validate_path`: Check that the path/command combination is valid.
- `view`: Implement the view command
- `str_replace`: Implement the str_replace command, which replaces old_str with new_str in the file content
- `insert`: Implement the insert command, which inserts new_str at the specified line in the file content.
- `read_file`: Read the content of a file from a given path; raise a ToolError if an error occurs.
- `write_file`: Write the content of a file to a given path; raise a ToolError if an error occurs.
